singleVisionLenses.name: MySV®
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients with astigmatic prescriptions struggling with peripheral distortions, those limited in frame selection due to lens thickness, or anyone wanting 360° visual comfort.
patientBenefits: Wider peripheral views than standard single vision lenses

singleVisionLenses.name: iD Single Vision®
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients with high prescriptions needing thinner lenses and increased viewing area.
designFeatures: Bi-aspheric design using HOYA's free form technology.
Aspheric curves on both front and backside of the lens.
patientBenefits: Expanded peripheral viewing, especially in higher prescriptions.
Optimized visual acuity and crisper image perception.
More relaxed vision thanks to precise and effortless focusing.

singleVisionLenses.name: Sync III®
singleVisionLenses.targetUsers: Patients with a digital lifestyle experiencing digital eye strain.
designFeatures: Power boost design with options: Sync III 5 (+0.57D), Sync III 9 (+0.95D), Sync III 13 (+1.32D), and NEW Sync III 20 (+1.89D).
Considers Position of wear and frame measurements.
patientBenefits: Reduces eye strain during prolonged digital device use.

progressiveLenses.name: iD MyStyle® 3
progressiveLenses.description: HOYA's most advanced and personalized lens design, incorporating all of HOYA's latest patented technologies.
keyFeatures: Nearly 400 design variations based on patient lifestyle and previous glasses
Five convenience options: Tyro, Expert, Detail, Modern, Adventure
patientBenefits: Seamlessly visual comfort for any activity in all environments
Faster adaptation and clearer vision by reducing peripheral astigmatic distortion
Reduced peripheral prismatic imbalance for elevated comfort
Tailor-made lenses for the most discerning PAL wearers

progressiveLenses.name: iD LifeStyle® 4
progressiveLenses.description: Enhanced version of HOYA's bestselling LifeStyle lens design with added 3D Binocular Vision™ technology.
keyFeatures: Three design options: Indoor, Urban, Outdoor
patientBenefits: 3x less peripheral deformation for faster adaptation
Reduced occurrence of unwanted prismatic effects in near-range peripheral vision
Easier adaptation with fewer distortion areas

progressiveLenses.name: Array® 2
progressiveLenses.description: Applies HOYA free form backside surfacing technology to any semi-finished lens in any material.
keyFeatures: Consistent performance across clear and sun options
patientBenefits: Consistent experience when wearing clear indoor glasses or outdoor sun protection

progressiveLenses.name: Amplitude® BKS/Mini
progressiveLenses.description: Economical lenses designed to suit any budget with comfortable design for most lifestyle needs.

Easy to clean (stays easy to clean 10x longer)
patientBenefits: Easy to clean features that last much longer

antiReflectiveCoatings.name: Recharge®
antiReflectiveCoatings.description: Treatment that reduces blue light exposure through a combination of absorption and reflection.

patientBenefits: May help alleviate eye strain, fatigue, headaches, loss of focus and blurred vision (DES)

antiReflectiveCoatings.name: Clear Blue Filter®

Safety built into the lens, not the coating
patientBenefits: Provides comfort from sunlight, screen time, and everyday activities
Helps safeguard eyes from conditions linked to UV high-energy blue light
